name: Tension Fabric Stand Straight
description: The Straight Tension Fabric Stand offers a sleek and professional appearance, making it ideal for events and exhibitions. It features premium stretch fabric paired with a sturdy yet lightweight Aluminium frame, ensuring durability and easy setup. With multiple size options available, it’s a great choice for retail branding, exhibitions, and corporate displays across the UAE.

name: Tension Fabric Stand Curved
description: Elevate your brand presence with the Curved Tension Fabric Stand, designed to create a smooth and modern display. Built with a durable aluminium frame and high-quality stretch fabric print, it delivers a sleek curved look that stands out at exhibitions and indoor branding setups. Available in 230x230cm and 300x230cm sizes, it offers a premium visual impact for professional displays.

name: VINYL POP UP STAND STRAIGHT
description: The Straight Vinyl Pop Up Stand is a reliable option for creating bold and impactful branding displays. Constructed with a strong aluminium frame and high-quality vinyl panels, it delivers a vibrant, glossy finish that grabs attention. Available in sizes ranging from 2x3 to 6x3, it’s well-suited for exhibitions, indoor promotions, and retail environments across the UAE.

name: VINYL POP UP STAND CURVE
description: The Curved Vinyl Pop Up Stand brings a refined and dynamic touch to your brand displays. Crafted with a curved aluminium frame and high-resolution vinyl panels, it creates a sleek, professional finish with added depth. Perfect for exhibitions, retail branding, and media backdrops, it’s designed to make a strong visual impact across the UAE.

name: ROLL UP
description:
Our Roll Up Stand (Standard) is a practical and professional display solution for exhibitions, retail promotions, events, and corporate branding. Designed with a strong aluminium base and smooth pull-up mechanism, it provides a clean and elegant presentation for your printed banner.

Lightweight, portable, and easy to assemble within minutes, this roll up stand is ideal for both indoor marketing and promotional setups across the UAE. Each stand comes with a support pole and carry bag for convenient transportation and storage.

Features:

  • High-quality aluminium base
  • Smooth roll-up spring mechanism
  • Durable and stable structure
  • Easy to install and remove graphic
  • Includes carry bag for portability
  • Perfect for events, exhibitions, and retail branding

name: POP UP TABLE 200cm x 95cm
description:
The Pop Up Table (Curve) is a stylish and practical promotional counter designed for exhibitions, retail promotions, events, and brand activations. Featuring a strong folding aluminium frame with a curved tabletop design, it provides a professional front-desk look while remaining lightweight and easy to carry.

Built for quick setup, this pop up table includes a smooth PVC/vinyl wrap branding area that can be customized with your artwork, making it perfect for showcasing your brand in a clean and modern way. Ideal for trade shows, malls, corporate events, and product launches in the UAE.

name: EXHIBITION TENT
description:
The Exhibition Tent is a durable and professional outdoor branding solution designed for exhibitions, outdoor events, promotional campaigns, and corporate activations. Made with a strong foldable metal frame and a high-quality weather-resistant canopy, it provides excellent shade and protection while giving your brand maximum visibility.

This tent is easy to install and can be customized with your logo and artwork, making it ideal for trade shows, sports events, market stalls, and promotional setups across the UAE. Its sturdy structure ensures stability, while the large print area delivers a premium advertising presence.
